decisions.statement: A script names a file in this checkout against the root the script found.
The root is written `$AKASHA_ROOT`, `${AKASHA_ROOT}` or `${AKASHA_ROOT:-a fallback}`.
A name begins after the separator that follows the root.
A name runs from the root to the closing quote of the word holding it.
Every name a line holds is answered rather than the first alone.
A line naming no such file holds no name.
A root with no quote directly before it holds no name.
A word holding a further expansion holds no name.
A name built on a variable other than the root is not read here.
Whether a name reaches a file that is there is not judged here.

definition: the paths a composed script names under the checkout root
